design.purpose: Rerank stocks already visible in the early Radar; Radar itself is not redesigned.
design.radar: price/base-liquidity pool plus ANY(RS21,RS42,RS63)>=85; no Full Eligibility and no market gate
design.leader_label: annual liquid Top5, frozen independently of the candidate ranker
design.selection_split: 2016-2020 development chooses one named score at DDV20 only; 2021-2025 is untouched holdout
design.primary_kpi: first Top3/5 ranking while stock is still <=+30%/+50% from annual-period start price
design.theme: leave-one-out peer theme score; target stock is excluded from theme calculation
design.theme_acceleration_caveat: delta is on the strongest LOO theme score and can contain a best-theme switch; therefore it is exploratory, not an adopted rule
